misconceptions.title: Assignment always copies the value
misconceptions.description: Assignment always makes an independent copy, even for mutable objects.

misconceptions.title: Assignment is an algebraic equation
misconceptions.description: Assignment establishes a persistent algebraic relationship between names.

misconceptions.title: Floor division truncates toward zero
misconceptions.description: Integer floor division truncates toward zero for negative operands.

misconceptions.title: Arithmetic is strictly left to right
misconceptions.description: All arithmetic operators are evaluated strictly left to right.

misconceptions.title: Only literal booleans control conditionals
misconceptions.description: Only literal True/False can control a conditional.

misconceptions.title: Separate if statements are mutually exclusive
misconceptions.description: Separate if statements act like mutually exclusive elif branches.

misconceptions.title: Slice stop index is inclusive
misconceptions.description: The stop index is included in a slice.

misconceptions.title: Indexing starts at one
misconceptions.description: The first item has index one.

misconceptions.title: range includes its stop bound
misconceptions.description: range includes its stop bound.

misconceptions.title: Returning and printing are the same
misconceptions.description: Printing a result makes it the function return value.

misconceptions.title: Local assignment rebinds the global
misconceptions.description: Assignment inside a function automatically rebinds a same-named global.

misconceptions.title: A shallow copy is a deep copy
misconceptions.description: Copying the outer container also copies all nested mutable objects.

misconceptions.title: Dictionary iteration yields values
misconceptions.description: Iterating a dictionary yields values rather than keys.

misconceptions.title: A typed except catches everything
misconceptions.description: A typed except clause catches every exception.

misconceptions.title: Comprehension loop variable leaks
misconceptions.description: Python 3 list-comprehension loop variables overwrite the enclosing variable.

misconceptions.title: Mutable defaults are recreated per call
misconceptions.description: A mutable default is created anew for each function call.

misconceptions.title: An exhausted iterator restarts
misconceptions.description: Reusing an exhausted iterator restarts it.

misconceptions.title: Generators run eagerly
misconceptions.description: A generator body runs fully when the generator is created.

misconceptions.title: Nested loops are always quadratic
misconceptions.description: Any syntactically nested loop is necessarily quadratic in input size.

misconceptions.title: A single loop is always linear
misconceptions.description: Any single loop has linear complexity, irrespective of work in its body.
